# Story Engine — External Dependency Docs (per-dep hub)

> **Go here first when you need to READ upstream docs for a dependency.** Each dep has its own folder:
> `reference/<dep>/README.md` is a curated, Story-Engine-tailored note (what it is, our pin, verified
> latest version, task→doc links, gotchas that bite us). Where the dependency publishes an upstream
> `llms.txt`, the raw file is vendored beside the note as `reference/<dep>/llms.txt` (offline, greppable).
>
> Split per-dep (from a single index) on 2026-07-24 so an agent grabs just the one dep it's touching.
> Versions verified 2026-07 — **re-check before relying on a pin.** Distinct from `research/llms.txt`,
> which indexes what our *own conventions* were distilled FROM (provenance, not dependency docs).

## Conventions
- Each folder: `README.md` (curated note) + optional `llms.txt` (verbatim upstream, only where one exists).
- Vendored `llms.txt` = offline speed; the README's task→doc links point at live upstream docs for current detail.
- "no upstream llms.txt" almost always = tiangolo family (FastAPI/SQLModel/Typer) or a docs site that doesn't publish one — re-probe before assuming.
